title: Component Editor Dialog
summary: Official Derivative dialog reference for customizing components and Script Operators, covering custom parameters, page/parameter editing, Extension Code, Shortcuts and Tags, Storage, dragged-parameter reference or bind choices, and clipboard JSON workflows.
guidance: Use this article when a plan needs UI-level grounding for customizing a COMP or Script Operator rather than direct Python-only parameter creation.
The Component Editor is opened from Customize Component and covers custom parameters, extension code, shortcuts and tags, and storage.
Copying parameters produces human readable JSON that can be edited and pasted back into the Component Editor.
Dragging an existing parameter into the parameter list can create a Reference or Bind relationship to the new parameter.
Use the Storage section for direct inspection and editing of a component's storage dictionary, but prefer custom parameters for user-facing controls.
